open_items.description: ADT-Link R44SF connector variant and removal of ALL host 3.3 V paths are not yet confirmed.
open_items.resolve: Confirm the part with ADT-Link; continuity-test every 3.3 V contact after modification. Validate 8 GT/s x1, cold/warm boots and zero AER. Validate a genuine power-cycle with LIME3V3 off, including signal backfeed.

open_items.description: Current-setting resistors R501 (RTL-A), R509 (HF+), R514 (T7) and R553 (IMU pack, U553) are engineering starting values (RILIM TBD); STACK §5.1 fixes only the rule 1.5–2× measured current. No measured device steady/startup currents or hot-corner proof.
open_items.resolve: Measure current/inrush; set the RTL-A/HF+/T7 limits to 1.5–2× the measured current as STACK §5.1 requires; confirm HF+ minimum startup ≥0.75 A. Run the STACK §8 TPS2553DBVR-1 item 3 inrush test on latching U503 (HF+ LC 100 µH/100 µF + 220 µF damper) at final RILIM; only if it latches, fit TPS2553DBVR (constant-current) on this channel alone. Retry/latch test at all battery states; scope LC overshoot. IMU pack branch (R-E5-08): measure the pack supply current at the J504 lead (start-up and streaming) and set R553 to 1.5-2x (start 88.7k, 265-339 mA); short the far end of the 2 m cable and confirm U553 limits without latching, recovers after the short is removed and LAB5 does not droop below the E1-05 limits.

open_items.description: T7 VBUS rail capacity and modified cable SuperSpeed signal integrity untested.
open_items.resolve: With a real T7 prove J5 load <1.5 A expected operating budget, VCC_5V_PERI <=14 W, 5000M/UAS, no USB resets, fio, hot-corner TJ <=105 C for 1.5 A. Re-evaluate rail/switch/cable if failed.

open_items.description: HDMI/display/hub and receiver backfeed paths through signal lines need physical power-state validation.
open_items.resolve: Verify Q6A off / LAB5 on / display on combinations using DMM/FNB58. Q6A HDMI 5 V and Q6A USB VBUS should remain 0 V within measurement resolution. Check DDC/HPD after U506 installation and no phantom receiver power.

open_items.description: EDL factory button pads and cable orientation not physically located on the exact received Q6A.
open_items.resolve: Use the factory button first; continuity-identify its two switch nets before fitting parallel SW501. Unplug T7 for EDL and confirm 05c6:9008.

open_items.description: Project locking connector/GX16 numbers have been assigned but final keyed part footprints/orientation and wire lengths are not released; the J551 pod power receptacle (M8 3-pin, contacts 1/3/4) still needs its wall position and a confirmed mounting side (MECH-07).
open_items.resolve: Record exact supplier part numbers, face-view and wire-color tables; no-power continuity plus first energization current limit.

open_items.description: Radiated-noise behavior and USB2 touch enumeration are physical integration gates, not determined by netlist.
open_items.resolve: Run the STACK A/B noise matrix (HF+, GNSS, L-band, T7 authorized=0/off), cable strain relief and environmental tests; do not mark production-ready before passes.

open_items.description: Wi-Fi/BT Q6A (FCU760K, AIC8800 на порту 4 FE1.1s) у польовому/QUIET root вимкнено лише програмно: blacklist з install /bin/false, udev authorized=0 за шляхом порту 4 і rfkill як другий шар. Апаратне утримання WIFI_PWR_EN (GPIO TLMM через CJ3134K до WIFI_PWR_EN_3V3, схема Radxa v1.21, с. 4) на отриманій платі не знайдено; gpio-hog у польовому DTBO не створено й не виміряно.
open_items.resolve: W1-2 (STACK §8): домашній root з увімкненим Wi-Fi, тепле, а потім холодне перезавантаження в польовий root — на порту 4 FE1.1s немає пристрою (lsusb -t), немає мережевого пристрою wlan і hci0. Знайти лінію TLMM WIFI_PWR_EN, застосувати gpio-hog output-low у польовому DTBO, виміряти 0 V на живленні модуля й підтвердити, що домашнє розблокування працює; dpkg -l aicrf-test — пакет відсутній. До закриття authorized=0 без прив’язаного драйвера не вважати апаратним вимкненням.

decisions.description: UART service, LAB BUS, GX16 and J21 locking harness contact mappings assigned as PROJECT design; molded numbering must be used at assembly.
decisions.source: OriginalSTACK only gave signals; final wiring tables in E5-review.md.

decisions.description: Replace unspecified HDMI Schottky D501 by low-loss LM66100DCKR ideal diodeU506 withCE=VOUT. Maintains intended source→display isolation while reducing supply drop.

Initial current limits (RILIM TBD, starting values): RTL-A 43.2k, LAB 34.8k (STACK value), HF+ 28.7k, T7 DRV 15.8k. RTL-A, LAB and HF+ use latch-off TPS2553DBVR-1 as STACK §5.1/§5.2 specify; HF+ moves to non-latching TPS2553DBVR only if the STACK §8 inrush test fails. T7 (not a STACK TPS2553 position) uses non-latching TPS2553DRVR for startup.
decisions.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/gpn/tps2553; bench-current and thermal tests still required.

decisions.description: T7 switch on existingJ5VBUS only, no populatedLAB5 alternative. DRV package chosen for better thermal resistance, initial limit guarantees about1.5A againstSamsung rating.
SLED detect assignedLAB BUS pin6, remote mating jumper toGND; existingE3 pullup10k to3V3_Q6A.
TCA9517 added to E5 cable interface: both rails and EN from3V3_Q6A, B-side one4.7k pull-up pair, A-side no additional pull-ups. Existing/remote parallelpulls must be removed or DNP.

Use LM66100 ST open-drain output as local5V diagnostic with100k pull-upR552 andTP502. Manufacturer ground-tie recommendation applies only if unused. Keeps correct OD electrical type and removes direct ST-ground powerflag ERC collision without blanket exclusions.
decisions.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm66100.pdf; section5 pin functions and section6.5ST current/voltage limits.

decisions.description: IMU pack branch: U553 = TPS2553DBVR constant-current (LCSC C55266) with IN and EN on LAB5 and OUT E5_IMU5V to J504.1, U551.3, J550.1, U552.3 and D502.2; RILIM R553 start 88.7k (265-339 mA); C552 100 nF at IN, C553 1 uF at OUT; FAULT_N to TP503.
decisions.source: TI SLVS841G p.14-15 (constant-current recovery); the external 2 m cable is the likely short, and a fast electronic limit keeps the shared LAB5 from drooping the way a PTC would; no MCP output, S02 wire or software change. build/15 'Межі струму тонких гілок (W2 GR-1)'.

decisions.description: W425 enters the main case through J551, a keyed panel receptacle binder M8 A-coded 3-pin (76 6618 1111 00003-0200) with the mating field-wireable plug 99 3379 100 03 on W425: BIAS_SB_LNA on contact 1 (brown lead), GND on contact 3 (blue), contact 4 (black) unused. S36 ends at J551, S41 is the W425 cable.
decisions.source: binder data sheets read 2026-11-07 (parts snapshot 2026-11-07-w2-reads-e-manual.json); the M8 shell family differs from GX16 (J504) and GX12 (J505, its drawing read the same day), so no IMU or LAB BUS plug fits; a captive pod gland stays at the pod end only. build/15 'Ключування панельних роз'ємів J504/J505/J551 (W2 GR-1)'.

power_flags.reason: Known power after passive L501: U503.OUT drives100uH L501 then VBUS_HFP. Flag identifies actual filtered power without changing module power_in types.
Known power after D502 Schottky: LAB5→U553→E5_IMU5V→SS14 anode→cathode E5_IMU_VIN supplies E3 IMU MCU. Flag declares powered-after-passive path only.
power_flags.source: STACK.md §5.1 reverse-feed rules; D502 in E5.json; https://www.vishay.com/doc?88746=

drawing_notes.text: R501 = RILIM TBD (старт 43.2k 1%, 0.544–0.673 A). STACK для VBUS RTL-A задає лише правило RILIM = 1.5–2× виміряного струму; номінал STACK є тільки для порту LAB (R505 34.8k). Ворота: E5-04.

U503 = TPS2553DBVR-1 (засувка), як у STACK §5.1/§5.2. TPS2553DBVR зі сталим струмом (LCSC C55266) — лише на цьому каналі й лише якщо канал HF+ не пройде тест пускового струму STACK §8 (TPS2553DBVR-1, п. 3) при остаточному RILIM: LC 100 µH/100 µF + демпфер 220 µF ≈ 5.3 ms проти мін. deglitch 5 ms. R509 = RILIM TBD (старт 28.7k 1%). Ворота: E5-04.
R514 = RILIM TBD (старт 15.8k 1%, 1.51–1.73 A). STACK не задає RILIM для ключа T7 (U505 TPS2553DRVR без засувки — проєктне рішення R-E5-03/R-E5-04). Ворота: E5-04, E5-05.

U553 = TPS2553DBVR зі сталим струмом (не -1): КЗ у 2-метровому кабелі IMU обмежується без засувки й без GPIO. R553 = RILIM TBD (старт 88.7k 1%, 265–339 mA за рівняннями TI SLVS841G); STACK номіналу не задає, лише правило 1.5–2× виміряного струму. Ворота: E5-04.

J551 — панельна розетка M8 A-код 3 конт. (binder 76 6618 1111 00003-0200), вилка W425 — 99 3379 100 03: інший корпус, ніж GX16-4 J504 і GX12 J505, тож кабель IMU чи LAB BUS у неї не входить. Контакти 1/3/4 (контакту 2 немає): 1 — BIAS_SB_LNA (коричневий вивід), 3 — GND (синій), 4 — вільний (чорний вивід — не GND, ізолювати). Місце на стінці й бік монтажу — MECH-07. Ворота: E5-08.
